name: Izumi Hisaomi
source:
The managing director of the record label DYNAMIC CHORD. His slogan is "tenacity" and he's a skilled boss. Since his eyesight is extremely bad, Hisaomi always has his glasses on.

[Translation of [URL=http://www.honeybee-cd.com/dynamic/reve/append.html]official website character profile[/URL].]
